description: Checkout persistence + polish + version bump (Expo app). Issue 3 (HIGH): checkout.tsx proceed() never writes to the addresses table, so an inline-entered address that is never explicitly 'Save Address'-ed is lost and the saved list stays empty on the next visit. Fix by persisting the inline address on proceed() the same way saveFromEditor does, guarded against double-saving an already-selected saved address. The payload builder is extracted to a pure, unit-tested helper. Issue 2 (minor): show an already-known email as confirmed/read-only. Also bump versionCode to 25. Independent of FEAT-001/002 at the code level (different files), but ordered last so identity is stable first.
steps: Add mobile/src/addressPayload.ts exporting a pure `buildAddressPayload(c, label, selectedId)` that returns exactly the object checkout.tsx currently posts to /addresses: { action, id, label, receiver_name: c.name, phone: c.mobile, house_no: c.address, landmark: c.landmark, city: c.city, district: 'Aurangabad', state: 'Bihar', pincode: c.pincode, latitude: c.deliveryLat, longitude: c.deliveryLng, full_address: [c.address, c.city, c.pincode].filter(Boolean).join(', ') }. Rule: serverId = (selectedId != null && selectedId > 0) ? selectedId : undefined; action = serverId ? 'update' : 'create'; id = serverId. Keep it dependency-free (no React/api). Match the PendingPayload shape in src/store/addresses.ts.

Add mobile/src/__tests__/addressPayload.test.ts (node:test, following addresses.test.ts style) covering: no selectedId -> action 'create' and id undefined; negative selectedId -> action 'create', id undefined; positive selectedId -> action 'update', id equal to that value; full_address composition joins address/city/pincode with ', ' and skips empties; district/state are the fixed 'Aurangabad'/'Bihar'.

In mobile/app/checkout.tsx, refactor saveFromEditor to build its POST payload via buildAddressPayload(c, label, selectedId) (behavior unchanged — verify the resulting object matches the current inline literal).

In mobile/app/checkout.tsx proceed(), after all validation passes and before setPayOpen(true): when there is NO positive selectedId (i.e. the address came from the inline form, selectedId == null or <= 0), persist it like saveFromEditor — optimistic `upsertLocal(userId, addr)` (build the SavedAddress row the same way, using a negative temp id when none selected) and a background `api.post('/addresses', buildAddressPayload(c, label, selectedId))` with the same .then reconcile (drop temp row, keep server row, update saved + selectedId) and .catch(() => queuePending(userId, payload)). Do NOT await the network write — payment must still open instantly. Guard so when selectedId > 0 (an existing saved address was chosen) nothing is re-saved.

Issue 2 polish in checkout.tsx editor: when user.recovery_email || user.email exists, render the email as read-only/confirmed text (e.g. a labeled line showing the address with a small 'change' Button that flips to the existing editable Field). Keep email OPTIONAL and non-blocking — do not add validation and do not make it required anywhere (proceed() must not start requiring email).

In mobile/app.config.ts bump the versionCode default from 23 to 25: `const VERSION_CODE = Number(process.env.STORE4A_VERSION_CODE || 25);`. Leave an inline comment that the notifee-rich-push branch uses 24 and the owner must coordinate the final merge/build so one AAB at versionCode 25 contains BOTH change sets.
Commit locally on branch identity-checkout-fixes (do not push).
acceptance_criteria: mobile/src/addressPayload.ts exports buildAddressPayload producing the exact create/update payload the old inline literal produced; it imports nothing from React/api.
npm test includes passing addressPayload cases (create for no/negative id, update for positive id, full_address join, fixed district/state).

proceed() persists an inline-entered address (optimistic upsertLocal + background POST with queuePending fallback) when no positive selectedId, and does NOT double-save when an existing selectedId address was chosen; payment still opens without awaiting the network.
A known email (recovery_email || email) renders as confirmed/read-only with a change affordance; email remains optional and never blocks proceed().
app.config.ts VERSION_CODE default is 25 with the owner coordination comment.

findings: Implemented all FEAT-003 steps. (1) Added mobile/src/addressPayload.ts exporting pure buildAddressPayload(c,label,selectedId); it imports only `type PendingPayload` from ../store/addresses (erased at runtime) and nothing from React/api, so the __tests__ loader never needs a new mock. serverId = (selectedId!=null && selectedId>0) ? selectedId : undefined; action = serverId?'update':'create'; district/state fixed to Aurangabad/Bihar; full_address = [address,city,pincode].filter(Boolean).join(', '). (2) Added mobile/src/__tests__/addressPayload.test.ts (6 node:test cases) covering no/negative/positive selectedId, full_address join + empty-skip, fixed district/state, and full field mapping. (3) checkout.tsx saveFromEditor now builds its POST body via buildAddressPayload(c,label,selectedId) — same object as the old inline literal (verified field-by-field). (4) proceed() now persists an inline-entered address when there is NO positive selectedId (null or negative temp): optimistic upsertLocal with id = selectedId ?? -Date.now(), then a background api.post('/addresses', buildAddressPayload(...)) with the same .then reconcile (drop temp row, keep server row, update saved + selectedId) and .catch(queuePending) fallback. The network write is not awaited and setPayOpen(true) still runs immediately, so payment opens instantly. Guarded by `!(selectedId!=null && selectedId>0)` so a chosen existing saved address is never re-saved. (5) Issue 2: added emailEditing state + knownEmail = (user.recovery_email||user.email).trim(); the editor renders the known email as a read-only confirmed line (✅ email) with a small 'बदलें / change' Button that flips to the existing editable Field. Email remains OPTIONAL — no validation added and proceed() does not require it. (6) app.config.ts VERSION_CODE default bumped 23 -> 25 with a comment that notifee-rich-push uses 24 and the owner must coordinate the final merge/build into one AAB at versionCode 25. Did NOT touch any notification code or the notifee-rich-push worktree. Verification: `npm test` -> 51/51 pass (incl. 6 new addressPayload + existing addresses tests); `npm run typecheck` -> exit 0, no new errors (pre-existing usesCleartextTraffic config-types note did not surface and is ignored per instructions).
